name: Suncity Synthetics Ltd.
summary: Suncity Synthetics Ltd. engages in the business of manufacturing polyester fiber and nylon granules. The firm also offers clothing fabrics, home furnishing, automobile furnishing, non-woven carpet, non-woven carry bags, and regenerated granules. The company was founded on February 25, 1988 and is headquartered in Surat, India.
